title: Uncontrolled source titles: When Nature, Science, and PNAS meet Scopus
abstract: arXiv:2611.25627v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bibliographic databases such as Scopus and Web of Science play a critical role in literature discovery, systematic reviews, bibliometric analyses, and research evaluation, yet their reliability depends on effective control of the quality of the bibliographic data. This study examines the problem of uncontrolled source titles in Scopus by comparing five possibly adopted journal-level retrieval strategies across three flagship journals-Nature, Science, and PNAS. Substantial discrepancies across retrieval results indicate persistent fragmentation in the source title field. A comparative analysis using the Web of Science Core Collection shows that no comparable degree of uncontrolled source-title variation is observed for the same journals. translated_title: 非受控的来源刊名：当Nature、Science和PNAS遇上Scopus
translated_abstract: 诸如Scopus和Web of Science等文献数据库在文献发现、系统性综述、文献计量分析和科研评估中发挥着关键作用，然而其可靠性取决于对文献数据质量的有效控制。本研究通过在三种旗舰期刊——Nature、Science和PNAS——上比较五种可能被采用的期刊级检索策略，考察了Scopus中来源刊名缺乏规范控制的问题。检索结果之间的巨大差异表明来源刊名字段存在持续的碎片化现象。利用Web of Science核心合集进行的对比分析显示，相同期刊并未观察到类似程度的来源刊名非受控变异。研究进一步探讨了可能的成因机制，包括从（不同的）上游数据提供商继承下来的不同刊名形式、自动解析及OCR相关的错误痕迹，以及交叉验证不足。
tldr: Scopus数据库中来源刊名缺乏规范控制，导致Nature、Science和PNAS三大期刊的检索结果碎片化且不一致，而Web of Science中不存在此类问题，研究并揭示了刊名变异源于上游数据商继承、自动解析和OCR错误及验证不足等机制。
en_tdlr: Uncontrolled source-title variations in Scopus produce fragmented and inconsistent retrieval results for Nature, Science, and PNAS—a problem absent in Web of Science—with causes traced to upstream provider inheritance, automated parsing and OCR artifacts, and insufficient cross-validation.
